__comment: Weather definition. Loaded by the WeatherManager autoload. One file per weather type.
BASE + OVERRIDE model: a weather file overrides only the deltas of data/sky/sky_settings.json
via 'sky_overrides'. 'clear' is the baseline weather and overrides nothing.
DATA ONLY. Selection (weighted per season), scheduling, and the gradient/curve crossfade live
id                           - namespaced weather key (used by data/calendar/weather_schedule.json)
vision_multiplier            - GAMEPLAY sight/streaming radius scale (1.0 = full). Separate from
the fog 'distance' look; multiplies WorldRenderer view radius and
camera far clip (ties weather to the doc-06 streaming budget).
hide_cloud_shadows           - suppress moving cloud shadow projector (future)
snow_accumulation_per_minute - per game-minute snow cover delta; negative = melt/decay
sky_gradient                 - per-weather sky gradient PNG (faithful sky-shader route only;
omit if driving ProceduralSky colours from data)
sky_overrides                - partial sky_settings.json (only the curves that differ from base)
thoughts                     - mood thoughts applied to dwarves while active (see 41_dwarf_agents.md)
Keys beginning with '__' are documentation comments and are skipped by the loader.
